  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially after sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) or trending downward.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome is consistently below forecast over 3-5 days (e.g., 2024-09-18–2024-09-20).",
    "Avoid overreacting to early sentiment signals — delay correction until 2–3 days after sentiment shift.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with 30-day moving average.",
    "If sentiment is neutral (0.00) and forecast is consistently high, apply downward correction to prevent overestimation."
  ]
}
